info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Payouts-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Payouts API provides access to a comprehensive list of payouts associated with insurance claims. This endpoint allows users, such as insurance agents and claims adjusters, to efficiently retrieve detailed information about payouts for various claims. By querying this API, users can streamline the claims handling process and improve customer service by ensuring timely updates. The API is designed to facilitate quick access to critical financial data relevant to insurance claims, enhancing transparency and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the payout information associated with claims. It provides detailed data about the current status and amounts related to each claim's payout.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving payout information related to claims. It should contain all necessary parameters to filter and retrieve the desired payout data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the payout details.
